l1_connect_account.title: Bring the file servers nobody watches under the console
l1_connect_account.why: Departments keep their files on these servers, but the console does not see them, so their snapshots, permissions and capacity go unchecked.
steps: List file servers from the network and the directory, including branch offices.
Register each one with the console using the documented service account.
Confirm shares, snapshot schedules and capacity show for each.
l1_connect_account.success: Every file server in scope reports its shares and snapshots.
